snippet.title: Golf 5 MAX - Teaser Trailer - Release Window Announcement
snippet.description:
Golf 5 MAX — The arcade golf experience where ‘80s retro flair meets modern precision. 
Train iconic characters, each with unique playstyles, and level them up through RPG-style progression as you master drives, chips, and putts with classic, addictive timing-based gameplay.

Take on escalating challenges in a competition where every shot matters and every upgrade shapes your path to glory. Own the rhythm, sharpen your precision, and lead your golfers to greatness in a vibrant, ‘80s-inspired sports broadcast world. Are you ready to forge the next golf legend?

Coming 2026 to PC
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3929380/Golf_5_MAX
